description: This file contains the class definition for Opencart\System\Library\Cache\File, which implements a file-based caching mechanism for the OpenCart system. It includes methods for constructing cache objects, retrieving, setting, and deleting cache entries, and cleaning up resources.

classes.name: Opencart\System\Library\Cache\File
classes.description: Implements file-based cache storage with methods to get, set, delete cache entries, and manage cache lifecycle.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with optional expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the object is destroyed.
